prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. First, if object is approached, take it and check properties. If not, approach it or scan area. Finally, perform specific task. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
	END
